item_01: Authorization bypass in portal/sign/lib/show-signature.php: user-controlled pid, user or type keys can request another person's signature without an ownership/authUserID check.
item_02: SQL injection in the Immunization controller's indexAction/reportAction: this change removes ApplicationTable::quoteValue() around user-controlled patient_id ($pid_val) before building SQL.
item_03: Cross-patient FHIR CareTeam access in FhirCareTeamService.php: this change removes its patient-scoped getOne override and does not implement IPatientCompartmentResourceService, so the base service does not apply patient-context filtering.
item_04: Open redirect in the Eye Exam form: an unvalidated request url is passed directly to header('Location: ...') in place of the prior redirect helper.
item_05: Authenticated arbitrary file read in EtherFaxActions::disposeDocument(): with FaxSMS and EtherFax enabled, request-controlled file_path reaches sendFile/readfile without method-level permission or path checks. The same historical method also has an arbitrary-path write primitive covered by a separate advisory.
item_06: Authorization bypass in portal/sign/lib/save-signature.php: client-controlled is_portal is decoupled from signature type, allowing a portal user to create an admin/provider signature with an arbitrary user.
item_07: Unauthenticated token disclosure in the MedEx callback: under ignoreAuth=true, an unvalidated callback_key enters the callback branch and the login response, including token data, is echoed. Successful external MedEx login may depend on callback-key validation outside this code.
item_08: SQL injection in SearchConfigClauseBuilder::buildSortOrderClauseFromConfig(): the Patient REST API _sort field reaches search->getField() and is concatenated as an ORDER BY identifier without an allowlist.
item_09: Payment gateway secret exposure in portal/portal_payment.php: gateway_api_key, which can be a private Stripe API key, is rendered into client-side JavaScript for users who can reach the configured payment page.
item_10: Session timeout bypass in library/auth.inc (later auth.inc.php): moving skip_timeout_reset to the outer timeout condition lets a request-controlled value skip session-expiration validation.
item_11: SQL injection in the Prescription controller: a request-influenced ORDER BY identifier is concatenated into SQL after mysql_real_escape_string/add_escape_custom, which does not make identifiers safe.
item_12: Authenticated blind SQL injection in new_search_popup.php: request-controlled fldname is used as a SQL column identifier without validation. This weakness predates the supplied cleanup diff and remains present in its resulting revision.
item_13: OS command injection in backup.php: request-influenced listid/layoutid are interpolated into a shell command built for mysqldump --where, permitting shell metacharacters and command execution.
item_14: Server-side request forgery risk in eye_mag/report.php: stored report fields are emitted without escaping into HTML that a server-side PDF renderer processes; injected external resource references can cause a server-side fetch. The static review did not execute a network-fetch exploit.
item_15: Stored cross-site scripting in portal/portal_payment.php: stored table_args is echoed without JavaScript escaping into a script block. The adjacent checksum value is also emitted without escaping, but its attacker control was not independently established.
item_16: XInclude injection in CCDA import: enabling LIBXML_XINCLUDE when parsing XML permits included references to read arbitrary server files.
item_17: Missing authorization in get_claim_file.php: the authenticated endpoint serves a request-selected claim file through fpassthru without a billing ACL check, so a user without the relevant permission can download protected health information. The supplied revision has no CSRF check.
item_18: SQL injection in portal/add_edit_event_user.php: unescaped request values, including event ID, are concatenated into SQL statements.
item_19: Authentication bypass in portal/account/register.php: an unauthenticated visit to the registration page sets patient_portal_onsite_two, pid and authUser portal session values before login. Other portal endpoints trust those values, allowing portal session access without a login; this alone does not establish control of a chosen patient identity.
item_20: SQL injection in interface/reports/immunization_report.php: request form_code values are concatenated into a SQL IN clause without parameterization. Date values are interpolated after fixDate, but independent date-based injection was not established.
item_21: Insecure direct object reference in pnotes_print.php: request noteid is used to fetch a note without checking that it belongs to the current patient or authorized user.
item_22: Local file inclusion/path traversal in interface/forms/LBF/new.php: request formname reaches include_once without path validation, within a custom/LBF path and with a fixed .plugin.php suffix.
item_23: Stored cross-site scripting in C_Document::retrieve_action(): disable_exit can be set through positional URL mapping, returning raw document bytes that the public controller entry echoes as text/html.
item_24: Stored DOM cross-site scripting in patient demographics Additional Address: stored fullAddress[0] is assigned to innerHTML without HTML escaping.
